description: Returns the full content of a single document — invention, patent application, strategy, or report — or a meeting identified by its search result ID. A meeting returns a Markdown snapshot of its canvas text notes and all stored transcript sessions, with speakers, timestamps, and session status. A document has several texts across its lifecycle; a bare document ID returns the most advanced one (the newest application text, else the priority draft, else the innovation description), and the response lists every part with its own ID, such as document:<id>#priority_draft or document:<id>#application_text:<revisionId>. Pass a part ID to read that text instead.

id.description: The search result ID, such as meeting:<id>, or a document identifier
